# AIToolsFinder (aitoolsfinder.cloud)

> Compare 1,200+ AI tools and B2B SaaS products with audited pricing tiers, capability teardowns, and side-by-side alternatives.

AIToolsFinder is an independent AI and SaaS directory built for engineers, marketers, founders, and small teams who want clear pricing and real capability comparisons before buying software.

## Key Links

- [Home Directory](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/): Browse and filter 1,200+ AI tools and SaaS products by category and pricing model.
- [Explore Catalog](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/explore): Full searchable directory with category, pricing, and tag filters.
- [Tool Finder](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/ai-finder): Match AI tools to a specific job or workflow.
- [Side-by-Side Compare](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/compare): Compare features, pricing models, and capabilities across tools.
- [Rankings](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/rankings): Category and tag rankings based on audited benchmarks.
- [Guides & Blog](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/blog): Practical guides on pricing audits, AI coding assistants, and lean team stacks.
- [XML Sitemap](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable index of all tools, categories, comparisons, and guides.
- [Full Context (llms-full.txt)](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/llms-full.txt): Extended markdown summary for AI search and RAG retrieval.

## Primary Categories

- [Developer Tools](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/categories/developer-tools): AI code editors, terminal agents, copilot extensions, and code review tools.
- [Productivity](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/categories/productivity): Workspace assistants, task automation, meeting notes, and document tools.
- [Marketing](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/categories/marketing): Ad creative tools, campaign copywriters, and conversion optimization.
- [Writing & SEO](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/categories/writing): Long-form drafting tools, SEO workflows, and editing assistants.
- [AI & Models](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/categories/ai): Foundation models, LLM APIs, and inference gateways.
- [Sales & Business](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/categories/sales): CRM assistants, outbound automation, and lead enrichment.
- [Design & UI](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/categories/design): UI generators, vector tools, and design system helpers.
- [Automation](https://aitoolsfinder.cloud/categories/automation): Workflow builders, webhooks, and browser agents.
